Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Knoxville hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 10 of the 15 Knoxville hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 3, Traveluro at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Vio.com at 2 and HotelTonight.com at 1. These are the Knoxville rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Knoxville hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at TownePlace Suites by Marriott Knoxville Cedar Bluff to 19% at Tru by Hilton Knoxville North I 75. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
